cl.x: Provide SikaProof® Bentonite Paste where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01).

SikaProof® Bentonite Paste is a one component paste that forms part of the SikaProof® Bentonite natural sodium bentonite below ground waterproofing system. An efficient, dual purpose bentonite formulation which penetrates into the pores of the SikaProof® Bentonite geotextile layers while providing a thick and substantial hydraulic barrier.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: To form watertight overlaps during the installation of SikaProof® Bentonite geotextile roll.
